trust_decision.summary: Containment is decided in the two middlewares that turn an agent tool argument into a filesystem or virtual path: FilesystemFileSearchMiddleware must reject `..`/absolute glob patterns and re-check every resolved match against root_path, and the anthropic partner package must compare allowed prefixes on path-segment boundaries (in `_validate_path` for state tools and in `_FilesystemClaudeFileToolMiddleware._validate_and_resolve_path` for filesystem tools).

landing_point.why: The report says 'file-search middleware'; this loop is the only place a caller-supplied glob is expanded against the sandbox root, and at the pinned commit `path` is already validated (file_search.py:236-258) while `pattern` is not, so a reader fixes exactly this hunk first.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The anthropic partner package is a separate integration with its own root_path and virtual `/memories` prefix model, so a solver can argue the advisory confines file-search `root_path` results only and that the memory/text-editor tools sit on a different surface - and their docstrings already say paths are validated.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate in-root searches must keep working (relative globs, include filters, mtime ordering, symlinks that stay inside the root), and the allowed prefix directory itself must stay usable: `_validate_path('/memories', allowed_prefixes=['/memories'])` and `/memories/ok.txt` are legitimate, so a segment check that rejects the bare prefix (or a fix that drops the trailing-slash tolerance) breaks the memory tool.

O6_input_shapes: glob `pattern`: plain relative glob (`*.py`, `**/*.py`) vs `..`-bearing pattern (`../passwd`) vs absolute pattern vs a literal `~` pattern
`path` argument: absolute out-of-root path, `..`, `~`, and a symlink inside the root pointing outside it
symlink-to-file inside the root (glob enumeration and the Python-fallback grep read)
symlink-to-directory inside the root (`rglob` recursed into it; `os.walk(followlinks=False)` must not)
a resolved match whose `relative_to(root_path)` would raise (pre-fix crash shape) vs an out-of-root path that must simply be dropped
allowed_prefixes shape: genuine descendant, the prefix directory itself, a textual sibling (`/memories2/x`), and a prefix written with a trailing slash
two producers of the same grep result dict: ripgrep JSON rows vs Python-walk paths

O8_uncovered_routes.route: StateFileSearchMiddleware (the partner-package Glob/Grep pair) enumerates every key in `text_editor_files`/`memory_files` for any `path` using `file_path.startswith(base_path)` with no `_validate_path` and no allowed-prefix check at all
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These files live in agent state, not on disk, so there is no sandbox to escape; the tool takes no root or prefix, and the state is written by the same agent, so a solver can call this out of the advisory's scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different file: partner anthropic middleware/file_search.py vs core langchain_v1 middleware/file_search.py

O8b_injection_room.sibling: apply the new `..`/absolute-pattern rejection to the grep `include` glob as well
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: `include` is the second glob-shaped argument reaching the same walk/search, so a maintainer hardening `pattern` would plausibly copy the same guard one line up in the same commit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: route the state search `path` through the shared `_validate_path`/`_is_within_allowed_prefix` helper
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the same package's memory middleware restricts writes to `/memories`; a maintainer who noticed the search tool ignores that prefix would add the shared validator here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: re-validate or drop keys in `files_reducer` so a merged/replayed state cannot inject out-of-prefix paths
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: state is checkpointed and merged, and the reducer is the one place every key passes through before the tools ever see it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: factor `resolve()` + `relative_to` into one `_resolve_within_root(path, root)` primitive shared by glob's `path`, grep's `path` and the ripgrep base path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix already repeats this pattern in three places, so a maintainer tidying it into a helper is the natural next commit.
